name: werknario-webide-agent-workspace
description: Web-native KI agent for the GitLab Web IDE: reads the document substrate, proposes edits as a diff, opens a merge request. No terminal. CI is its hand.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @werknario/shared && npm run build -w @werknario/gitlab-client && npm run build -w @werknario/proxy && npm run build -w werknario-webide-agent
